SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.password, u.trade_password, u.parent_id, u.avatar, u.ancestors, u.sex, u.email, u.credit_score, u.balance, u.frozen_balance, (u.balance + u.frozen_balance) AS total_balance, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.last_login_time, u.account_status, u.trade_status, u.withdraw_status, u.real_name_status, u.real_name, u.id_card_number, u.id_card_front, u.id_card_back, u.withdraw_name, u.withdraw_address, u.withdraw_type, u.create_time, u.remark, u.is_real, u.level_id, u.commission, u.all_commission, u.deal_count, u.card_number, u.card_amount, u.version,
( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_withdrawal w WHERE w.user_id = u.id AND w.application_time >= CURDATE() AND w.application_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS today_withdraw_count,
u.total_withdraw_count, u.today_reset_count, u.total_reset_count, u.withdraw_tip,
-- 父级信息 parent_user.username AS parent_username, parent_user.phone AS parent_phone,
-- 直属下级数量 (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_member_user d WHERE d.parent_id = u.id) AS direct_sub_count,
-- 所有下级数量（使用 FIND_IN_SET 替代 LIKE） (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_member_user a WHERE FIND_IN_SET(u.id, a.ancestors)) AS all_sub_count,
-- 等级信息 l.id AS levelId, l.icon, l.name_zh, l.name_en, l.price, l.auto_upgrade_invite_count, l.commission_ratio, l.streak_commission_ratio, l.min_balance, l.order_count, l.withdraw_count, l.withdraw_limit, l.min_withdraw_amount, l.max_withdraw_amount, l.withdraw_fee, l.withdraw_order_per_day, l.description_zh, l.description_en, l.create_time AS levelTime,
-- 使用当前余额作为累计充值金额 u.balance AS total_recharge,
-- 最大可达等级价格（小于等于当前余额） (SELECT MAX(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price <= u.balance ) AS max_level_price,
-- 下一等级价格（大于最大可达等级的最小价格，如果无最大等级则取最小价格） (SELECT MIN(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price > COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(l3.price) FROM order_member_level l3 WHERE l3.price <= u.balance ), -1 -- 使用一个负值作为占位符，确保 > -1 总是取 MIN(price) )) AS next_level_price,
-- 计算距离下一等级所需的充值金额 COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price > COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(l3.price) FROM order_member_level l3 WHERE l3.price <= u.balance ), -1 ) ) - u.balance, 0 ) AS recharge_needed_for_next_level
FROM order_member_user u LEFT JOIN order_member_level l ON u.level_id = l.id LEFT JOIN order_member_user parent_user ON u.parent_id = parent_user.id

parent_id = #{userId}
